capabilities: Find notes by any word form using Russian and English morphological search
Insert wikilinks that preserve the typed text as display text
Link to specific headings and blocks with previews
Replace the native [[ suggest with inline morphological suggestions
Match across note titles, frontmatter aliases, and wikilink display texts
extras: Not yet in the official community plugin list; the README recommends installing via BRAT or manually while awaiting review. Dictionaries are built from OpenCorpora (CC BY-SA 3.0) and WordNet data; no typo tolerance yet, fuzzy matching is planned.
intentEvidence: Replace Obsidian's native link autocomplete with the plugin's morphological search.
problem: Obsidian's native [[ link autocomplete only matches exact title prefixes, so typing an inflected word form or different word order fails to find the target note.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin from Obsidian Community Plugins if you haven't already.

summary: Link-search plugin that finds notes by morphological word forms, word order, and prefixes when inserting wikilinks.
